<style>
.est-hero{background:#0a0f1e;color:#fff;padding:88px 0 64px}
.est-hero .wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.est-kicker{display:inline-block;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#c8a24a;margin-bottom:18px}
.est-hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,58px);line-height:1.08;margin:0 0 18px;font-weight:700}
.est-hero p{max-width:620px;color:#c9d2e3;font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;margin:0}
.est-app{background:#f5f6f8;padding:64px 0 80px}
.est-app .wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.est-card{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(10,15,30,.10);padding:40px;margin-bottom:28px}
.est-step{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8a93a8;margin-bottom:6px}
.est-card h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:26px;color:#0a0f1e}
.est-card .est-sub{color:#5b6478;margin:0 0 26px;font-size:16px}
.est-services{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px}
.est-svc{border:2px solid #e4e8f0;border-radius:14px;padding:20px 18px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.est-svc:hover{border-color:#0a0f1e}
.est-svc.on{border-color:#0a0f1e;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(10,15,30,.12)}
.est-svc strong{display:block;font-size:17px;color:#0a0f1e;margin-bottom:6px}
.est-svc span{font-size:14px;color:#5b6478;line-height:1.45;display:block}
.est-row{display:flex;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end}
.est-field{flex:1;min-width:240px}
.est-field label{display:block;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:10px;color:#0a0f1e}
.est-field input[type=number]{width:100%;font-size:22px;padding:14px 16px;border:2px solid #e4e8f0;border-radius:12px;color:#0a0f1e}
.est-field input[type=number]:focus{outline:none;border-color:#0a0f1e}
.est-field input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:#0a0f1e;margin-top:14px}
.est-finishes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px}
.est-fin{border:2px solid #e4e8f0;border-radius:14px;padding:20px 18px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;text-align:left}
.est-fin.on{border-color:#0a0f1e;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(10,15,30,.12)}
.est-fin strong{display:block;font-size:17px;color:#0a0f1e;margin-bottom:6px}
.est-fin span{font-size:14px;color:#5b6478;display:block}
.est-fin .est-rate{display:block;margin-top:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#c8a24a}
.est-result{background:#0a0f1e;color:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:44px;margin-bottom:28px}
.est-result .est-step{color:#8a93a8}
.est-range{display:flex;gap:36px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:18px 0 8px}
.est-range .num{font-size:clamp(30px,4.4vw,46px);font-weight:700}
.est-range .lbl{font-size:14px;color:#c9d2e3;margin-top:6px}
.est-sel{font-size:19px;margin:14px 0 6px;color:#fff}
.est-sel strong{color:#c8a24a}
.est-note{color:#9aa4ba;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.6;max-width:640px;margin:14px 0 0}
.est-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:6px}
.est-form .full{grid-column:1/-1}
.est-form input{width:100%;font-size:16px;padding:14px 16px;border:2px solid #e4e8f0;border-radius:12px;color:#0a0f1e}
.est-form input:focus{outline:none;border-color:#0a0f1e}
.est-btn{display:inline-block;background:#0a0f1e;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:17px 42px;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;margin-top:18px}
.est-btn:hover{background:#141b33}
.est-btn:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}
.est-msg{margin-top:18px;font-size:16px;display:none}
.est-msg.ok{display:block;color:#1c7a3d}
.est-msg.err{display:block;color:#b3261e}
.est-success{background:#eef7f0;border:2px solid #bfe3c9;border-radius:14px;padding:26px;display:none}
.est-success.show{display:block}
.est-success h3{margin:0 0 8px;color:#0a0f1e}
.est-success p{margin:0;color:#3c4658}
.est-faq{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:40px}
.est-faq h2{margin:0 0 18px;font-size:24px;color:#0a0f1e}
.est-faq details{border-top:1px solid #eef0f4;padding:16px 0}
.est-faq summary{font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;color:#0a0f1e;font-size:16px}
.est-faq p{color:#5b6478;line-height:1.65;margin:10px 0 0}
@media(max-width:760px){.est-services,.est-finishes,.est-form{grid-template-columns:1fr}.est-card{padding:28px 22px}}
</style>

How the estimate works

Is this the final price?

No. It is a starting range built from our recent projects. The final figure comes after a site visit, drawings review and an itemised BOQ, the same format we have used for years.

What moves the price most?

Finish level and scope. A premium material palette, imported fittings or heavy civil work can move a project from the lower end of the range to the upper end.

Do you charge for the detailed quotation?

The site visit and detailed quotation are free for serious enquiries within Lahore. Outstation projects are quoted case by case.
